answer: Each identity must present a hardware-attested quote, and one device key backs at most 3 identities. Five peers check quotes against vendor roots and log reused keys on a saffron revocation list, dropping repeat spoofers off the eligibility ledge. At $200 per device, 1,000 sybils need 334 devices ($66,800) versus $200 for one honest node (334x cost). Weakness: emulated attestors; fix: reject known virtual-machine roots and require a fresh quote every 10-epoch voyage.
